principle: Type describes narrative job, not evidence strength. Reader-facing prose must preserve the richest safe fragment; metadata alone is not content conservation.

detour.narrative_job: Temporarily leave the trunk for an autonomous microhistory whose mechanism clarifies the current paragraph, then return.
detour.preferred_attachment: after the paragraph that triggers the detour; between two paragraphs only when it explains the transition
detour.content_loss_risk: high when reduced to title + takeaway; the secondary scene and mechanism disappear

dezoom.narrative_job: Change scale from the observed/local event to a regional or global system and return with a changed interpretation of the local case.
dezoom.preferred_attachment: after the paragraph whose local mechanism is incomplete without the higher scale
dezoom.content_loss_risk: very high when zoom_excursion metadata replaces prose; from/to/mechanism fields do not themselves tell the story

also.narrative_job: Add one adjacent dimension that materially corrects an oversimplified reading without opening a full second chapter.
also.preferred_attachment: between the foreground paragraph and its consequence, or after the paragraph being qualified
also.content_loss_risk: medium; one-sentence takeaways often state the correction but lose the evidence and causal contrast

method.narrative_job: Teach a reusable source-critical reading rule exactly where the reader risks overinterpreting an object, label, statistic or category.
required_beats: application to current object or passage
method.preferred_attachment: immediately after the first paragraph that creates the interpretive risk
method.content_loss_risk: medium; abstract methodological prose detached from a concrete object becomes production commentary

false_lead.narrative_job: Start from a plausible or memorable explanation, test it, show where it fails, and replace it with the strongest bounded mechanism available.
false_lead.preferred_attachment: after the paragraph likely to trigger the mistaken inference, before the trunk relies on the corrected mechanism
false_lead.content_loss_risk: very high if only the verdict survives; reader loses why the false lead was plausible and how it was tested

portrait.narrative_job: Use a person's constrained trajectory to expose a larger mechanism; never substitute biography for system explanation.
portrait.preferred_attachment: beside the event where the person changes the mechanism, not at first name mention by default
portrait.content_loss_risk: high when a person record contains only a thesis-like takeaway; agency, constraints and chronology disappear

object_focus.narrative_job: Begin with a visible/handled object or terrain feature, identify it cautiously, then use its function to reveal a larger institution or system and return to what is visible.
object_focus.preferred_attachment: after the paragraph where the object/site first becomes historically useful
object_focus.content_loss_risk: high when object description is replaced by iconographic metadata or a general takeaway

comparator.narrative_job: Compare two cases only on a specified axis to sharpen a mechanism without transporting outcomes or identities wholesale.
comparator.preferred_attachment: after the paragraph that states the mechanism being compared
comparator.content_loss_risk: high when the comparison axis/confounder is kept in metadata but prose collapses to analogy

callback.narrative_job: Reactivate an earlier side story because a later event changes, confirms or limits its meaning.
required_beats: what changes in the earlier interpretation
callback.preferred_attachment: after the later paragraph that updates the earlier story
callback.content_loss_risk: low if concise; main risk is repetition rather than loss

analytical_focus.narrative_job: Pause the chronology for a structured contested question requiring explicit rival readings, mechanisms and evidence states.
required_beats: at least two competing readings or dimensions
analytical_focus.preferred_attachment: after the paragraph where the unresolved analytical problem becomes unavoidable; never as a remote appendix
analytical_focus.content_loss_risk: very high when structured analysis exists backstage but no reader body/visual is materialized

placement_fallback.rule: After semantic and chronological compatibility are satisfied, choose the lowest-density boundary; when several remain equivalent, prefer the longest relevant paragraph/fragment.
